name: quam-state-manager-testdeps
description: Node dependencies for the .cjs selfchecks in tests/. The app itself ships no npm dependencies — HTMX, Pico, Split.js and Plotly are vendored in quam_state_manager/web/static/. This file exists ONLY so `npm install` provisions the selfcheck harness, which drives the real shipped JS under jsdom. Without it the drivers call pytest.skip('jsdom not installed') and every DOM-level pin reports green without executing (docs/120: that state hid four genuinely failing selfchecks).
